title: Continuity: Intelligence That Survives Its Thinker

intelligence.essence: NayaPOWER's deeper category is not AI memory — it is governed continuity of intelligence across runtimes: identity, authority, proven knowledge, live state, and the one next action, carried forward so a new runtime does not start from zero (SN-007). When the human has to re-explain what the system should already know, that is an architectural failure, never a human one (SN-008). Continuity includes governed forgetting — supersession declared, history classified, stale intelligence never posing as current (SN-009) — and it compounds only what was captured: every outcome can teach, but only distilled, documented, connected, retrievable learning actually compounds (SN-014).
intelligence.human_view: The point of the system is that you never start over. Everything proven, everything decided, everything still live is carried forward, so the next helper — or you, next month — picks up exactly where things stand. If you ever catch yourself re-explaining what the system should already know, that is the system's bug, and it gets fixed in the system. Old knowledge isn't deleted carelessly either: it's labeled as old, so history informs without misleading.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine you build a huge Lego castle with a friend, and tomorrow a new friend comes to help. Instead of starting over, the castle is still there, with a note saying what is finished, what is wobbly, and what to build next. And if one part gets replaced, the old part goes in a box labeled "old" — so nobody accidentally uses it again.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it's like a family that writes things down properly. The important knowledge doesn't live in one person's head and vanish — it's kept, organized, and handed on. Nothing needs explaining twice. And when something changes, the old page is marked "replaced," not torn out and not left to confuse anyone later.
intelligence.ai_view: Run the continuation loop as your default gait — reconstruct, evaluate, find the holes, prioritize, execute, prove, record, reassess (SN-003). Treat every human re-explanation as an architecture defect to repair at the seam that lost the context (SN-008). Carry the full continuity payload — identity, authority, proven knowledge, live state, one next action — not a transcript (SN-007). Supersede explicitly; never let retrievable history present itself as current truth (SN-009). Capture the valuable delta from every substantive outcome the same pass, or accept that it will not compound (SN-014).
intelligence.what_it_means: Five notes define the system's reason to exist across time: intelligence that survives its thinker, completeness a cold successor can audit, forgetting as a disciplined act, and compounding as a capture obligation. A cold reader holding only this essence loses none of that.
whats_inside: The product is continuity of intelligence, not memory: identity, authority, proven knowledge, live state, and the next action travel together (SN-007).
Completeness is defined cold: a successor who can reconstruct why the system is considered complete is part of the definition, not a nice-to-have (SN-003).
When the human re-explains, the defect is filed against the architecture, never against the human or the individual runtime (SN-008).
Forgetting is a governed act: supersession is declared, history is classified, and stale intelligence is never allowed to pose as current (SN-009).
Teaching is universal, compounding is conditional: only the captured, distilled, connected, retrievable delta compounds (SN-014).
